objective.text: Apply a retry budget only to safe transient failures instead of retrying every domain rejection.

difficulty.rationale: Keep bounded retries for failures that another attempt can plausibly resolve.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: A read-only remote eligibility check returns 503 for a temporary outage and 422 for a stable business rejection. No client input changes between attempts.

stem: Which retry classifier fits these contracts?

options.rationale: That reverses the stated distinction between stable rejection and transient outage.
options.misconception: That reverses the stated distinction between stable rejection and transient outage.

options.text: Retry only when the JSON body is empty, regardless of status.
options.rationale: Body emptiness does not encode this service’s transient-versus-domain failure contract.
options.misconception: Body emptiness does not encode this service’s transient-versus-domain failure contract.

options.text: Retry every non-2xx response with the same budget.
options.rationale: That spends attempts on a domain rejection the contract says will not change for this input.
options.misconception: That spends attempts on a domain rejection the contract says will not change for this input.

options.text: Retry the temporary 503 within a small budget; return the 422 rejection without repeating identical input.
options.rationale: The read is safe to repeat and the transient outage may recover, while unchanged input will not resolve the specified stable rejection.
